Name: Glass
Description: Напівпрозоре скло, світлі контури й м’які відблиски.
StyleResources:
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:fx="clr-namespace:CategoryBar.Theming;assembly=CategoryBar">
<ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.MaterialTemplate" TargetType="ContentControl">
<Grid><Border x:Name="liquid" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{Binding Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}">
<Border.Effect><fx:ThemeShaderEffect Shader="liquid" P0="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.refraction}" P1="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.rim-light}"/></Border.Effect>
</Border>
<Border Margin="1" BorderThickness="1,1,1,0" BorderBrush="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.rim-color}" Opacity="0.12" Visibility="{DynamicResource Theme.Parameter.show-rim.Visibility}" CornerRadius="{Binding Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
</Grid></ControlTemplate>
<ControlTemplate x:Key="Theme.WorkspaceTemplate" TargetType="fx:ThemeSurface">
<Grid><Grid.ColumnDefinitions><ColumnDefinition Width="216"/><ColumnDefinition/></Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
<ContentControl Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Sidebar}" Margin="12,10,8,16" Content="{TemplateBinding Header}"/>
<ContentControl Grid.Column="1" Style="{DynamicResource Theme.Page}" Content="{TemplateBinding Content}"/>
</Grid></ControlTemplate>
<Style x:Key="Theme.NavigationPanel" TargetType="StackPanel"><Setter Property="Orientation" Value="Vertical"/><Setter Property="Margin" Value="10,6,10,10"/></Style>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Window.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.28"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Page.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.28"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Tab.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.28"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.28"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Bar.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.28"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Toast.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.28"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Content.Enter" FillBehavior="Stop">
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.28"/>
<DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" From="10" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.28"><DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction><CubicEase EasingMode="EaseOut"/></DoubleAnimation.EasingFunction></DoubleAnimation>
</Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Exit" FillBehavior="HoldEnd"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" To="0" Duration="0:0:0.10"/><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="(UIElement.RenderTransform).(TranslateTransform.Y)" To="4" Duration="0:0:0.10"/></Storyboard>
<Storyboard x:Key="Theme.Menu.Switch" FillBehavior="Stop"><DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" From="0.35" To="1" Duration="0:0:0.14"/></Storyboard>
</ResourceDictionary>

Parameters.Label: Викривлення відблиску
Parameters.Description: Впливає на відблиск матеріалу, а не на зображення робочого столу.
